local timer = 60 local ticks = 0 local doorSwitch = 1 local hardpoint = false function onTick() doorSwitch = input.getBool(1)
if doorSwitch == true then doorSwitch = 1 if ticks <= timer then ticks = ticks + 1 end
slidersInOut = 1
if ticks >= timer then slidersOpenClose = 1 end
hardpoint = true -- Hardpoint Release = True end
if doorSwitch == false then doorSwitch = 0 if ticks > 0 then ticks = ticks - 1 end
slidersOpenClose = -1
if ticks <= 0 then slidersInOut = -1 end hardpoint = false -- Hardpoint Release = False end
output.setNumber(1, slidersInOut) output.setNumber(2, slidersOpenClose) output.setBool(1, hardpoint)
output.setNumber(3, ticks) output.setBool(2, doorSwitch) end

object.script:
function onTick() end
function onDraw() screen.setColor(150, 255, 100) dst(0, 0, "BIG", 4, 1, true) end
drf=screen.drawRectF pgt=property.getText
FONT=pgt("FONT1")..pgt("FONT2") FONT_D={} FONT_S=0 for n in FONT:gmatch("....")do FONT_D[FONT_S+1]=tonumber(n,16)FONT_S=FONT_S+1 end function dst(x,y,t,s,r,m)s=s or 1 r=r or 1 if r>2then t=t:reverse()end t=t:upper()for c in t:gmatch(".")do ci=c:byte()-31if 0<ci and ci<=FONT_S then for i=1,15 do if r>2 then p=2^i else p=2^(16-i)end if FONT_D[ci]&p==p then xx,yy=((i-1)%3)*s,((i-1)//3)*s if r%2==1then drf(x+xx,y+yy,s,s)else drf(x+5-yy,y+xx,s,s)end end end if FONT_D[ci]&1==1 and not m then i=2*s else i=4*s end if r%2==1then x=x+i else y=y+i end end end end
